summary: Checks whether a session is active by dereferencing the linked-list buffer global dword_7D2DB0 via LinkedListDereference. When the dereference yields non-null, marks the session active (return value 0), resolves a vehicle setup path from the same buffer through DelegationChain, loads the track scene from that path via TrackSceneLoader (falling back to the default byte_5EA438 path when the chain result is null), and runs the session scene sub-initializer sub_4A09F0 on this. Returns 1 when no session is active, 0 after the active-session scene setup path. Invoked by sub_4A0590.

local_names.this: session object (type unknown; ABI trust LEGACY Session_Active_Check)
local_names.v3: delegation chain result used as a source of the scene path
local_names.v4: resolved scene path string, defaulting to byte_5EA438 when null

operations.description: Initializes the return value v2 to 1 (inactive) before the session-activity check

Dereferences the linked-list buffer global dword_7D2DB0 via LinkedListDereference; a non-null result means a session is active and execution proceeds to scene setup, a null result keeps the inactive default
Marks the session active by setting the return value v2 to 0
Calls DelegationChain on the same dword_7D2DB0 buffer to resolve the vehicle setup path
The delegation chain result must be non-null; when null the scene load and session sub-initializer are skipped while the active (0) result is still returned
Reads the path string from the delegation chain result; when null, falls back to the default byte_5EA438 path
Loads the track scene from the resolved path string via TrackSceneLoader
Runs the session scene sub-initializer sub_4A09F0 on this
Returns v2: 1 when no session was active, 0 after the active-session scene setup path
Invoked by sub_4A0590 (004A0590), which consumes the result to gate subsequent session setup
